node.statement: For a linear map T:A->A, iota_n(T) acts entrywise on M_n tensor A. Thus every element of Im(iota_n(T)) has all entries in Im(T). Conversely, if Y=[Y_ij] has every Y_ij in Im(T), choose X_ij in A separately with T(X_ij)=Y_ij; then X=[X_ij] satisfies iota_n(T)(X)=Y. Therefore Im(iota_n(T))=M_n tensor Im(T).
